name: brand.create
description: A new brand in one of the caller's companies, with an empty kit, after the company's other brands in the switcher. Only the company's owners and admins add brands, themselves: never an agent. Its id comes from its name; a name whose id another brand holds is refused.
sql:
with b as (
  insert into brandbase.brands (id, org_id, name, handle, line, timezone, linked, position, created_at)
  select trim(both '-' from left(trim(both '-' from regexp_replace(lower(:name::text), '[^a-z0-9]+', '-', 'g')), 60)), :org, btrim(:name::text), :handle, coalesce(:line::text, ''),
    coalesce(:timezone::text, 'Asia/Singapore'), array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(:linked::jsonb)),
    coalesce((select max(x.position) + 1 from brandbase.brands x where x.org_id = :org), 0), :now::timestamptz
  returning *
),
k as (
  insert into brandbase.brand_kits (brand_id, org_id, voice, colours, logo)
  select b.id, b.org_id, '{"summary": "", "words": [], "examples": []}', '[]', '{"src": null, "name": null}' from b
)
select brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(b)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(b.created_at)) as result from b
